name: Effort
overview: Scripture teaches that effort is to be wholehearted and diligent, as seen in Ecclesiastes 9:10 and Colossians 3:23, where believers are called to do all their work with might and as unto the Lord. This effort is empowered by Christ, who strengthens us to accomplish all things (Philippians 4:13). Additionally, persistent seeking and asking are encouraged (Matthew 7:7), and our pursuits should promote peace and mutual edification (Romans 14:19), reflecting a Christ-centered motivation in all endeavors.
